title: Requirement import v1
description: config/requirements/imports/<inventory id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F2a): how the requirements of one inventory source are read where they are, without copying them. It declares what the source does not say: the state and type of the whole batch, its owner, the decision that retired it, and the need each requirement derives from.

derives_from.description: Source id -> the need it derives from; `*` for every id.

overrides.description: Source id -> the state and the retiring decision of one requirement whose state differs from the batch's.

implemented_by.description: D-332: the merged changes that implement the requirement when no commit's Implements: trailer names it (history the trailer rule of D-317 did not reach); CHG-initial is the initial public tree. The model reads each as an implements link from that change, which must exist and be merged.
